test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.

I can neither punish him nor reward him for __which he have done__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **what he has done**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the** present perfect tense**, which requires the use of 'has/have' with the past participle form of the verb.
 
• Therefore, the correct form of the verb 'do' in the sentence is 'has done'.
 
• Option 1) 'what he done' is incorrect as it uses the incorrect past tense form of the verb 'do'.
 
• Option 2) 'No improvement required' is incorrect as the sentence requires improvement.
 
• Option 4) 'which he has did' is incorrect as it uses the incorrect past tense form of the verb 'do' and the incorrect relative pronoun 'which'.

Therefore, the corrected sentence is: *I can neither punish him nor reward him for **what he has done**__*.
